|strategy=By [mailto:jbh@spam.dimensional.com Joe Helfrich]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/theshieldisdown.html</ref>

Ever since it was released, [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed{{!}}Rebel Strike Team]] has been one of those objectives that I really wanted to make a killer deck out of, but just couldn't quite manage one that could stand up to many different deck types. The Shield Is Down brings a wonderful power boost to the objective.

If this is one of your starting effects (along with say, [[Insurrection]] and [[Strike Planning]]) you'll be generating 6 force your first turn, even if your opponent doesn't give you any, enough to deploy both [[General Solo]] and General Madine to the Rebel Landing Site. Better yet, use 2 force to deploy the Bunker, deploy Back Door from reserve deck with [[The Shield Is Down!]] and use [[Insurrection]] to deploy the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Landing Platform and generate a whopping 12 force on turn 2! Or replace [[Insurrection]] with [[Squadron Assignments]], deploy [[General Solo]] aboard the Tyderium at [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]], and use [[Covert Landing]] to fill the shuttle with scouts. [[Luke Skywalker]] Jedi Knight, Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]], and [[Chewbacca]] of [[Kashyyyk]]--along with [[Luke's Lightsaber]], [[Anakin's Lightsaber]], and [[Chewbacca's Bowcaster]]--deploy for only 11 force to the Rebel Landing Site. If you have the force, you have the capacity to deploy up to 4 more scouts

characters landspeed of 2, or [[Corporal Beezer]] to get Obi's Journal from the reserve deck your next deploy phase. These guys should be more then enough to make any defensive force stationed in the bunker a little wary.

Better yet, that's just the first half of the card. Once you control the Bunker, you can blow it away. Then you can retrieve 8 force and make your opponent to put his hand in his used pile before he loses his 8 force. With no cards in his hand, you should have at least another turn before he can call up reinforcements!
